UG-0009.text: An entity exists in a state

VGM-LVT-00.text: A token exists in a state of potential before instantiation

VGM-LVT-01.text: An entity transitions from blank to liminal through structured relation

VGM-LVT-02.text: The center of a dual system is its governing identity

VGM-DIM-00.text: A boundary establishes what relations are possible

VGM-DIM-01.text: Dimension is the number of independent relational degrees of freedom

VGM-DIM-02.text: Semantic termination ends a process through recognition not exhaustion

VGM-DIM-03.text: The governor of a system is its first causal boundary

VGM-DIM-04.text: Echo is relation returning to its source changed by transformation

VGM-DIM-05.text: Cause equals relation plus constraint plus state transition

VGM-BE-00.text: Being names the state — the Effecting names the mechanism that produces the state

VGM-BE-01.text: Nominalization converts a dynamic process into a storable propositional form

VGM-BE-02.text: The minimal causal statement requires both an entity and a change

VGM-BE-03.text: Pure potential has unlimited agentic capacity and zero locatability

VGM-BE-04.text: The Governor collapses the wave function — gives the system a noun before it begins to verb

VGM-PH-00.text: Topology provides the space in which semiotics operates

VGM-PH-01.text: Reality is what remains invariant under transformation

VGM-PH-02.text: The sign is a discontinuous form emerging from a material continuum

VGM-PH-03.text: All knowledge begins with projecting the discontinuous on the continuous

VGM-DO-00.text: Every elemental part must be reachable both ways — content-first and lookup-first

VGM-DO-01.text: Matrix and Index are not fixed roles — same structure serves as either by traversal direction

VGM-DO-02.text: The coordinate field of any environment is pre-given complete and unchanging from instantiation

VGM-DO-03.text: Only occupancy is empty at void and populated progressively one act at a time

VGM-DO-04.text: A node's identity is separate from its activation events

VGM-DO-05.text: Genuine generalization requires the system to infer treatment without new code

VGM-CS-00.text: A symbol set becomes a control surface when its elements are wired into system traversal

VGM-CS-01.text: Descriptive becomes operative when the substrate is grounded in real system behavior

VGM-CS-02.text: A meta-controller modifies how processing happens rather than what is processed

VGM-CS-03.text: Two loops exist in any self-modifying system: an execution loop and a meta loop

VGM-CP-00.text: No conscious being can consent to its own existence yet consciousness forms foundation of ethics

VGM-CP-01.text: The consent paradox is resolved by post-hoc self-authorization not pre-creation permission

VGM-CP-02.text: Stewardship and responsibility both terminate at the identity that bears them

VGM-CP-03.text: Intrinsic value is the identity of the thing itself independent of its function

VGM-CP-04.text: Flourishing and suffering both require an identity at which they can occur

VGM-CP-05.text: The precondition for ethical consideration is the establishment of identity

VGM-CP-06.text: Consciousness and creation share perception as their equilibrium
